date.as_written: subha samvat 1053 sāl phāguna kṛṣṇa 14 roja bṛhaspatīvāra

purpose: thva postaka coyāgulīṃ jagat saṃsāra uddhāra juyamāla sakalayāṃ dharma cītra juyā śrītrīratnayā sarnasavonā mokṣapadalāthamāla (universal liberation / merit transfer)
notes: No individual personal names (scribe, patron, etc.) are recorded. Jinaśrīrāja and Jayaśrī are dialogue participants from the frame narrative of the Guṇakāraṇḍavyūha. The Sanskrit scribal verse contains corrupt variants of standard formulas (yādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā... / kaṣṭena likhitaṃ śāstraṃ...).
